theories.claim: DurableOperationManager.AcceptOperation correctly deduplicates on confirmation digest via operation-alias conflict resolution
theories.basis: AcceptOperation in durable_operations.go:97-112 persists Acceptance with OperationAlias=digest and ConfirmationDigest=digest; on ErrConflict and digest!="" it resolves existing alias via Repository.ResolveOperationAlias and returns Existing=true with original RunID without creating second run or claiming ownership
theories.verification_surface: static read of internal/app/durable_operations.go:97-138, internal/runcontrol/sqlite.go:378-484, internal/runcontrol/interfaces.go:49-52, and existing test internal/app/durable_operations_test.go:92-113
theories.confirmation_condition: Code shows digest-gated ErrConflict branch that calls ResolveOperationAlias and returns AcceptedOperation{RunID:existing.RunID, Existing:true} and does not attempt Claim/Append/control loop; test TestDurableOperationDeduplicatesAcrossManagersAndFailsClosed demonstrates two managers with same digest get second.Existing==true and same RunID
theories.refutation_condition: Code omits digest check, does not handle ErrConflict, resolves on wrong key, or returns new RunID/Existing=false on duplicate digest
theories.inconclusive_condition: Cannot determine resolution semantics without executing SQLite alias constraint path or observing concurrent Accept race
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only inspection of AcceptOperation, SQLite Accept alias constraint handling and ResolveOperationAlias, plus test assertions; no execution, no mutation

theories.claim: DurableOperationManager.AcceptOperation fails closed when repository is closed (does not return success or masquerade as ErrConflict)
theories.basis: When SQLiteRepository is closed, any Accept attempt hits sql.DB closed path classified as ErrUnavailable/ErrBusy via classifyStoreError, not ErrConflict; AcceptOperation's dedup branch is gated on errors.Is(err,ErrConflict), so closed error falls through to fmt.Errorf("persist confirmed operation acceptance: %w", err) preserving underlying CodeUnavailable for caller to distinguish from idempotence
theories.verification_surface: static read of internal/app/durable_operations.go:106-115, internal/runcontrol/sqlite.go:368-376 Close, 378-452 Accept + classifyStoreError:1088-1111, internal/runcontrol/errors.go:14-39, internal/runcontrol/fault_test.go:52-85, internal/app/durable_operations_test.go:116-123
theories.confirmation_condition: On closed repository, Accept returns non-nil error, errors.Is(err,ErrConflict)==false, wrapped with persist prefix, no Existing=true or fake Snapshot; fault test proves closed repo mutations return ErrUnavailable/ErrBusy
theories.refutation_condition: Closed Accept returns nil, returns ErrConflict, or returns Existing=true from stale alias resolution
theories.inconclusive_condition: Without runtime execution cannot observe exact sqlite driver error code after Close on this platform, but static classification covers busy/unavailable
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only inspection of Close, classifyStoreError constraint mapping, Accept error wrapping, and closed-repo test assertions at durable_operations_test.go:121-123; no execution
